definitions.gloss: the first score of the game
definitions.explanation: the initial point, goal, or run scored in a competitive match

examples.japanese: {先制点|せんせいてん}を{取|と}る。
{前半|ぜんはん}10{分|ぷん}に{先制点|せんせいてん}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: They scored the opening goal at 10 minutes in the first half.

examples.japanese: {先制点|せんせいてん}を{奪|うば}われたが{後半|こうはん}に{追|お}いついた。
examples.english: They conceded the first goal but caught up in the second half.

notes:
SPORTS TERM:
{先制点|せんせいてん} combines {先制|せんせい} (taking the initiative) + {点|てん} (point/score). Used across various sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先制点|せんせいてん}を{取|と}る/{決|き}める - to score first
- {先制点|せんせいてん}を{奪|うば}う - to snatch the opening score
- {先制点|せんせいてん}を{許|ゆる}す/{奪|うば}われる - to concede the first score

IMPORTANCE:
In many sports, the team that scores {先制点|せんせいてん} has a psychological advantage and often wins the game.

RELATED TERMS:
- {追加点|ついかてん} - additional score
- {同点|どうてん} - tie score
- {決勝点|けっしょうてん} - winning/deciding score
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん} - reversal/comeback
